verdict.rationale: An online tax and services portal could plausibly offer event-triggered rules, such as automatic payments or alerts on filing events, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents manual registration, filing, and payment flows (UTR/UTS) and file-based bulk reporting (QuickFile). Nothing shows user-defined rules that trigger actions automatically on events.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
